title: For leaders
title_one_paragraph_one: To ensure that scout meetings are fun and safe for you as a leader and for the children, knowledge and inspiration are important. Below is a description of courses offered at district level.
title_one_paragraph_two: These courses offer valuable and interesting content. HSS usually covers the course fee, as we want to invest in our leaders and assistants who are committed and do an excellent job.
title_one_paragraph_three: If you are interested in taking a course, please check with the board first.
title_two_paragraph_one: To ensure that our activities are safe for children and young people, there is this online leadership training. Through it, Scout leaders are trained in how to create a safe environment for children and youth, how to prevent abuse, and how to act if they suspect that someone is being harmed.
title_two_paragraph_two: Since 2013, it has been mandatory for all Scout leaders to complete this training every three years.
title_three_paragraph_one: ALU is the Scouts' own leadership training. If you are over 18 years old and have been an assistant in a section for at least one year, you are encouraged to take the course.
title_three_paragraph_two: There are different types of ALU courses: a full week in the summer, or the three-part course where you attend three weekends during October, February, and May.
title_three_paragraph_three: If you have a solid Scouting background in HSS, there is a risk that the course will not be fully rewarding, as you may already know much of the content.
title_three_paragraph_four: The program is focused on land-based activities and does not address issues related to sea scouting activities.
title_three_list_item_one: Excellent for making new contacts with other troops/leaders
title_three_list_item_two: Interesting to hear about other troops' challenges and programs
title_three_list_item_three: Many interesting and well-executed program ideas
title_three_list_item_four: Good for reflecting on the Scouting movement
title_three_list_item_six: It feels good to be a Scout
title_three_list_item_eight: Good to learn about Scouting ideology and history
title_three_list_item_nine: Perfect introductory course for new parents who are about to become leaders
title_four_paragraph_one: A very good course that provides practical tips on program activities for us Sea Scouts.
title_four_paragraph_two: Would you like to bring home Sea Scout program ideas for your troop?
title_four_paragraph_three: Would you like to feel more confident as a Sea Scout leader?
title_four_paragraph_four: Would you also like to go on a sailing hike in Stockholm's beautiful autumn archipelago?
title_four_paragraph_five: The goal is for participants to become better Sea Scout leaders. This is achieved by dividing them into patrols and letting them try out sea scouting program sessions so they can bring them back and run them in their own troops. In addition, leaders gain confidence by learning safety rules and the support available from the organization.
title_four_paragraph_six: The course is usually held over a weekend at the end of September.
